name: Sonaecom, S.G.P.S., S.A.
summary: Sonaecom, S.G.P.S., S.A., a global enterprise operating through its subsidiaries, focuses its business endeavors across the technology, media, and telecommunications sectors. Its extensive technology services encompass information systems consultancy, the development of sophisticated management platforms, and the online marketing of diverse products, services, and information. The company also sells licensed software and provides comprehensive research, development, consulting, maintenance, and auditing for a wide range of technological products, systems, facilities, communication services, and security systems, including their procurement and installation. Further, it specializes in creating and deploying IT, communications, and retail service solutions, alongside offering business and management advisory. Key capabilities also include the development, setup, implementation, training, and ongoing maintenance of software and system products, equipment rental, telecommunications service management, and strategic advice for the retail, industrial, and service industries. Specialized IT and cybersecurity consulting are also provided to institutions, banks, and insurance companies, with a focus on information security engineering. In the media landscape, Sonaecom undertakes the editing, composition, and publication of both periodical and non-periodical content, in addition to operating radio and television stations and studios. The company also delivers general management consulting and administrative services. Furthermore, it is actively involved in the investment and management of venture capital and venture capital funds. Sonaecom was established in 1988 and is headquartered in Cidade da Maia, Portugal.
